final: WITH station_usage AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_usage FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), phase_stations AS (SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, su.avg_usage FROM observatories o JOIN station_usage su ON su.observstation = o.observstation), phase_summary AS (SELECT lunarstage, AVG(avg_usage) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS station_count FROM phase_stations GROUP BY lunarstage) SELECT lunarstage, avg_bandusagepct, station_count, CAST(station_count AS REAL) / SUM(station_count) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM phase_summary
